record.question: Which among the following gases does not contribute to green house effect?
record.explanation: Methane, carbon dioxide and water vapour are standard greenhouse gases. Nitrogen dioxide is the least commonly listed greenhouse gas in standard textbooks, so it is selected as the one that does not contribute, with medium confidence.
